opportunities.name: Zap artillery bruiser
opportunities.objective: Test zap artillery bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Zap carries 1.4 total AD physical damage and a strong two-second slow; Shojin supports repeated W/E and Cleaver assists physical poke. Earned Muramana adds spell physical damage while Eclipse offers a shield after separate hits; rockets remain an occasional safe finisher.
opportunities.requiredState: Clear W sightline and enough mana after earning Manamune.
opportunities.failure: Minions block W and missing crit makes sustained rocket attacks weak.
opportunities.test: Compare W hit damage and casts over twenty seconds, plus a short attack phase.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: No AP amplification of Zap and no automatic crit on W.

opportunities.name: Chomper hybrid trapper
opportunities.objective: Test chomper hybrid trapper against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Flame Chompers has 1.0 AP magic damage and a 1.5-second root; hybrid Statikk and Nashor preserve attacks while Lich Bane supplies a magic packet after deploying traps. This tests E-led choke trades rather than claiming her physical rocket kit gains AP ratios.
opportunities.requiredState: Arm traps in a choke and land attacks while the victim is rooted.
opportunities.failure: Long E cooldown and easily avoided traps cripple the AP investment.
opportunities.test: Measure one trap hit plus three minigun attacks versus ordinary crit damage.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Each trap does not guarantee separate full damage or repeated root on one champion.

ruledOut.reason: No AP amplification of Zap and no automatic crit on W.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Zap artillery bruiser
builds.summary: Test zap artillery bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test zap artillery bruiser against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Zap carries 1.4 total AD physical damage and a strong two-second slow; Shojin supports repeated W/E and Cleaver assists physical poke. Earned Muramana adds spell physical damage while Eclipse offers a shield after separate hits; rockets remain an occasional safe finisher.
testPlan: Required state: Clear W sightline and enough mana after earning Manamune.
Compare W hit damage and casts over twenty seconds, plus a short attack phase.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Minions block W and missing crit makes sustained rocket attacks weak.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: No AP amplification of Zap and no automatic crit on W.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Muramana, Spear of Shojin, Black Cleaver, Eclipse, Edge of Night, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula: Jinx fires a shock blast that deals [10 / 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 + (1.4) × AD] physical damage to the first enemy hit, Slows them by [40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80]%, and reveals them for [2] seconds.

Jinx tosses out 3 chompers that last for [5] seconds. They explode on contact with enemy champions, Rooting them for [1.5] seconds and dealing [90 / 140 / 190 / 240 / 290 + (1) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies.

Jinx swaps weapons between Fishbones the rocket launcher and Pow-Pow the minigun.

While using the rocket launcher, Jinx's Attacks deal [(1.1) × AD] physical damage to the target and nearby enemies, gain [100 / 125 / 150 / 175 / 200] range, cost Mana, and scale [10]% less with bonus Attack Speed.

While using the minigun, Jinx's Attacks grant Attack Speed for [2.5] seconds, stacking up to [3] times (+[30 / 55 / 80 / 105 / 130]% %i:scaleAS% max).

Jinx fires a rocket that explodes on the first enemy champion hit, dealing [20 / 35 / 50 + (0.12) × AD[statFormula=2]] to [200 / 350 / 500 + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] + [25 / 30 / 35]% missing Health physical damage, gaining damage over the first second of travel time. Nearby enemies take [80]% Damage.

Missing Health damage cannot exceed [1200] against Monsters.
